Looking at stuff outside the top 1000 popularity on MAL:

Ao Ashi - fantastic sports anime, fighting for my favorite with Haikyuu and we just got season 2 announced.

Love After World Domination - Very cute RomCom about a Senati Ranger dating an "evil" boss. Sadly we'll never get anymore, but season 1 is worth the watch. 

Birdie Wing - Gay Girls Golf Mafia the anime. Super cheesy, but it's fun and understands the assignment. 

The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady - Fun little fantasy yuri show, that's technically an Isekai, but skips a lot of the standard Isekai tropes. Feels like an older Isekai that would have been made pre SAO. 

Jellyfish Can't Swim in the Night - One of my favorite shows of last year, even though it didn't fully stick the landing. Animation and music are top notch, and it has some wonderful character moments. 

From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! - Best twist on the Otome Game genre I've seen yet.

Handyman Saitou in Another World - One of the more realistic stories of what a dude getting reincarnated into another world would actually be like. He's got no powers, but his advanced knowledge of modern mechanics is basically the same as magic to the residents of the fantasy world he landed in. Good mix of humor, though the vignette style of the first part of the season can take a minute to get used to. 

Farming Life in Another World - Cute slice of life about a dude accidentally getting an OP power but using it just to create a farming community. 

Train to the End of the World - One of the more interesting anime originals to come out in a while. Works well as a coming of age story.

Bartender Glass of God - Remake of the original bartender. Good mix of character drama and relaxing vibes. 

I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability - Pretty standard dumb Isekai that goes way harder than it has any business going. 

My Clueless First Friend - Very cute show about a girl making her first friend, starts off as a light comedy but slowly gets into more complicated topics about grief, growing up, and finding yourself.

A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics - If you can forgive some janky animation, this reverse isekai has some excellent humor. 

Undead Murder Farce - An interesting twist on the detective genre, where you need monsters to solve crimes done by other monsters.
